Are you currently enrolled in a college or graduate program and seeking a valuable opportunity while you study? The Office of Investigations within the U.S. Postal Service Office of Inspector General is looking for passionate and driven students for our Student Cooperative program. This opportunity will support the Northeast Area Field Office (NEAFO) located in: Brooklyn, NY If you are interested in a career as a Federal Law Enforcement Special Agent in the USPS OIG, apply today!
About the Office of Investigations The USPS OIG's mission is to promote integrity, accountability, and efficiency of the U.S. Postal Service. In support of the mission, the Office of Investigations has special agents stationed all across the country conducting investigations in contract fraud, financial fraud, narcotics, mail theft, official misconduct, health care provider fraud, health care claimant fraud, and cyber crimes. This position is part of the Morale, Well-Being, and Recreation (MWR) Internship Program, which offers both paid and unpaid internship opportunities.
